topics.inclusion_rule: Speech or communication studies that record from implanted neural sensors (intracortical, ECoG, sEEG, depth) in humans or animals, classified by how the signal leaves the body: percutaneous connector or pedestal, wireless telemetry (including a transmitter mounted on a percutaneous pedestal), or a fully implanted system with no skin-penetrating hardware. Boundary: reviews and related-work mentions inflate the full-text counts (upper bounds); wearable EMG/EEG wireless devices are outside the population (ledger modality filter).

Same population as M13/wireless-implanted-speech-bci (implanted neural sensors, speech or communication); the design compared is where and by whom the system is operated: hospital or laboratory sessions (epilepsy monitoring, bedside, laboratory), sessions at the participant's home, and use without investigators present (independent use). Boundary: full-text pattern counts with the reference list removed, so related-work mentions count (upper bounds); a study counts under every setting it names; versions counted once.

Same population as M13/wireless-implanted-speech-bci; the design compared is the floor reported for decoding or selection accuracy: a chance level or shuffled or permutation null, and a false-positive (unintended selection) rate. Boundary: full-text pattern counts with the reference list removed (upper bounds; offline classification studies count); a study counts under every design it names.

inherited.M02: Task cues as labels; not described.
